description: Repeated live IBKR stock mark-refresh monitor that aggregates mark quality, fallback use, and paper-only quality actions across ticks.
required_behavior: Run repeated finite daemon batches during the allowed market session.
Attempt read-only IBKR stock mark refresh on each session-allowed tick.
Accumulate refresh pass/warn/block counts, policy status counts, quality action counts, delayed row counts, missing mark counts, and fallback symbol usage.
Append each batch and final summary to daily JSONL so the monitor can be reviewed after the session.
Keep M137 preflight and M140 paper-only quality actions active for each tick.
Never submit, stage, preview, transmit, close, or mutate real broker positions.
